title: Pins and grooved pins - Shear test
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 12982) covers Pins and grooved pins - Shear test. This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 8749 ; 1986 'Pins and grooved pins — Shear test' issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO) was adopted by the Committee and approval of the Light Mechanical Engineering Division Council. This standard has been prepared to support the latest versions of product standards on grooved pins wherein shear strength values have been incorporated. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
